INNER JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda ON tpd.trade_id = tpda.trade_id INNER JOIN WFL_PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL PTPD ON tpd.trade_id = PTPD.trade_id INNER JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl on sdl.dict_code ='BONUS_MODE' and sdl.item_code = tpda.pay_type INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fprod_type on fprod_type.FINPROD_ID = tpd.FINPROD_ID left join WFL_PA_TRD_FIN_DEAL_TOTAL btrd on btrd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID
left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = tpd.FINPROD_ID left join WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tpdt on tpd.totle_trade_id =tpdt.totle_trade_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT TC ON TC.FINPROD_ID = tpd.CHL_ID

INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda ON tpd.trade_id = tpda.trade_id INNER JOIN PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL PTPD ON tpd.trade_id = PTPD.trade_id INNER JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl on sdl.dict_code ='BONUS_MODE' and sdl.item_code = tpda.pay_type INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fprod_type on fprod_type.FINPROD_ID = tpd.FINPROD_ID left join PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL btrd on btrd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID
left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = tpd.FINPROD_ID left join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tpdt on tpd.totle_trade_id =tpdt.totle_trade_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT TC ON TC.FINPROD_ID = tpd.CHL_ID
mapper.select: select fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, fp.CCY CCY, fpt.TYPE_6 assetType, fp.FINPROD_ID finprodId, fp.TRADE_MARKET, fp.ISSUER from FIN_PRODUCT fp left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fpt.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID where fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId}

select pp.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, pci.ACCT_NO secManageAcctId from PTL_PORTFOLIO pp left join PTL_CAPACCT_INFO pci on pci.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID and pci.ACCT_TYPE = #{ACCT_TYPE_A01}
pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}

choose.otherwise:
select deal.TRADE_ID tradeId, dealAdd.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, dealAdd.REG_DATE registDate, decode(DEAL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID,'','',DEAL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID) secAcctId, decode(DEAL.Chl_Id,'','',DEAL.Chl_Id) chIld, fp.finprod_name chIldName, dealAdd.Pay_Type bonusMode, dealAdd.REG_DATE_AMT registShare, deal.UNIT_CPRICE unitCprice, deal.INT_AMT tradeAmt,
pp.INVEST_YESORNO investYesorno,
deal.SHARE_AMT qty
from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD dealAdd on deal.TRADE_ID = dealAdd.TRADE_ID
from WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal left join WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD dealAdd on deal.TRADE_ID = dealAdd.TRADE_ID
left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on dealAdd.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID left join fin_product fp on DEAL.Chl_Id = fp.finprod_id where deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{busiCode} and deal.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01}
and nvl(pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,'null') = 'null'

mapper.select: select fpv.VALUATION from FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION fpv, FIN_PRODUCT B where B.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = fpv.FINPROD_ID AND B.FINPROD_TYPE2 = fpv.FINPROD_TYPE2 and fpv.VAL_DATE <= #{valDate} and NOT EXISTS ( select 1 from FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION fpvt where fpvt.FINPROD_ID = fpv.FINPROD_ID and fpvt.VAL_DATE > fpv.VAL_DATE and fpvt.VAL_DATE <= #{valDate} )

select temp.* from ( SELECT T1.TRADE_ID, T1.BUSI_TYPE, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.FINPROD_TYPE, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2, T1.BRANCH, T1.TRADE_DATE, T1.VDATE, T1.MDATE, T1.SETTLE_DATE, T1.CCY, T1.UNIT_CPRICE, T1.UNIT_INT, T1.UNIT_FPRICE, T1.PAR_VALUE, T1.CPRICE_AMT, T1.SHARE_AMT, T1.PRIN_AMT, T1.INT_AMT, T1.FPRICE_AMT, T1.FEE_AMT_PAY,
nvl(T1.TRADE_AMT,T1.FPRICE_AMT) TRADE_AMT, T1.FEE_AMT_UNPAY, T1.FEE_AMT, T1.PS, T1.YIELD, T1.EXER_YIELD, T1.INV_AIM, T1.TRADE_STATUS, T1.IS_CANCEL, T1.P_TRADE_ID, T1.IS_CLEAN, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, T1.B_TRADE_ID, T1.COUNTER_ID, T1.IS_OUT_TRADE, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.TRADE_PLAT, T1.TRADE_MARKET_MODE, T1.TRADER, T1.COUNTER_TRADER, T1.COUNTER_CONTACT, T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, T1.F_TRADE_ID, T1.CASH_ID, T1.REMARK,
T1.CHL_ID,
T2.PORTFOLIO_ID,
case when t1.ps='T13' then t41.ORDER_ID else T4.ORDER_ID end ORDER_ID, case when t1.ps='T13' then t41.ORDER_TYPE else T4.ORDER_TYPE end ORDER_TYPE, case when t1.ps='T13' then t41.SETTLE_DATE else T4.SETTLE_DATE end PAY_SETTLE_DATE, case when t1.ps='T13' then t41.MY_ACCT_NO else T4.MY_ACCT_NO end MY_ACCT_NO, case when t1.ps='T13' then t41.SETTLE_AMT else T4.SETTLE_AMT end SETTLE_AMT, case when t1.ps='T13' then t41.CCY else T4.CCY end PAY_CCY, case when t1.ps='T13' then t41.PORTFOLIO_ID else T4.PORTFOLIO_ID end PORTFOLIO_ID_ORDER, rank() over(partition BY T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID,T2.PORTFOLIO_ID ORDER BY T1.TRADE_ID) rank
FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN WFL_STL_PAY_ORDERS T4 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T4.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 on T2.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T3.B_TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T5 ON T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T5.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_STL_PAY_ORDERS T41 ON T5.TRADE_ID = T41.TRADE_ID OR T41.TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID
FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS T4 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T4.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 on T2.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T3.B_TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T5 ON T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T5.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS T41 ON T5.TRADE_ID = T41.TRADE_ID OR T41.TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT TC ON TC.FINPROD_ID = T1.CHL_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID
WHERE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode}
and pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID =#{portfolioId}
and nvl(pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,'null') ='null'
) temp
where temp.rank = 1
SELECT TOTLE_TRADE_ID FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL WHERE B_TRADE_ID = #{bTrade} AND PS = 'T11' AND TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND (IS_CANCEL='N' OR IS_CANCEL IS NULL)
